caveats: The Q4 value is derived (annual figure minus nine-month year-to-date figure), not separately reported as a standalone quarterly figure.
The derivation inputs come from the FY2026 annual filing (accession 0000320187-26-000088) and the Q3 filing (accession 0000320187-26-000037).

claims.text: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31) was about $5.579 billion, derived as FY2026 cost of revenue of $26,487,000,000 minus the nine-month figure of $20,908,000,000.

raw_output.summary: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (March 1 to May 31, 2026) was about $5.579 billion. This is a derived figure: full-year cost of revenue of $26,487,000,000 minus the nine-month figure of $20,908,000,000.
